note: Short English glosses for the checked-in tool descriptions. The rendered option is the Chinese description plus this gloss. Tool ids stay out of the option text.

glosses.knowledge.index: build a full-text index for a document
glosses.knowledge.import: import a local file into the private library
glosses.knowledge.embedding_preview: preview index text that would be sent, without sending it
glosses.embedding.build: call an embedding model to vectorize a document
glosses.ocr.install_models: download the official OCR models onto this machine
glosses.ocr.recognize: recognize text on this machine without uploading the image
glosses.transfer.export: build a checksum package on this machine without sending it
glosses.transfer.import: verify a data package and accept it
glosses.transfer.send: send a checksum package to a paired device
glosses.inquiry.describe: describe the data model, its objects, relations, and fields
glosses.inquiry.search: find a material, supplier, or project by keyword
glosses.inquiry.get: read one record by id, including a deleted record
glosses.inquiry.query: filter one kind of record by field and count the matches
glosses.inquiry.related: follow relations to records that cite one record
glosses.inquiry.compare_quotes: group and compare every quote for one material
glosses.inquiry.quote_options: list usable quotes for one project material, lowest first
glosses.inquiry.project_budget: show a project cost budget: quantity, price, amount, and margin
glosses.inquiry.data_quality: check data quality for conflicts, duplicates, and unknown units
glosses.inquiry.spec_classes: read the parameter dictionary of equipment templates
glosses.inquiry.match_item: match materials to a technical requirement
glosses.inquiry.inquiry_matrix: show the quote matrix of budget lines by supplier
glosses.inquiry.object: read one business object by type and id
glosses.research.objects: read research projects, documents, or items in scope by title
